shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && cat package.json | head -90 && rg --files src/orchestration/tools | head'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && rg -n 'specs/.+#|spec:|spec anchor|validated by' src/orchestration -g '*.test.ts' | head -60"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files scripts/spec-links && rg -n 'ajv|strict|validateFormats' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts node_modules/ajv/package.json | head -50 && cat tsconfig.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat tsconfig.json && rg -n '\"@types/ajv\"|\"ajv\"' package-lock.json | head -30 && rg -n 'interface Options' node_modules/@types/ajv/index.d.ts node_modules/ajv/lib/ajv.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'interface ToolDefinition|inputSchema' src/types/ai.ts | head -20 && sed -n '55,95p' src/types/ai.ts && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '15,70p'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,80p' && git diff --check && git status --short"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs && git diff --stat && git diff src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,200p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n 'specs/|spec.*#|validated by' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts/lib | head -80"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'check-spec-anchor-names|spec:names' scripts src -g '*.test.*' | head -40 && rg -n '\\[specs/.+\\.md#' src | head -25"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Validate tool input with cached schema validators"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
